summary: Frontend-only foundation test for Detergent Formulator Pro (Expo Web). All 68 UI/navigation/theme/responsive checks passed with zero console errors across mobile (390x844) and desktop (1280x800) viewports.
critical_code_review_comments: Code is clean, well-structured with proper testIDs on all interactive elements.
ThemeContext correctly persists mode via AsyncStorage with @dfp:theme_mode key.
AppShell breakpoint at 1024px correctly toggles permanent sidebar vs drawer + hamburger.
All screens use React Native primitives (View/Text/Pressable) with StyleSheet.create().
context_for_next_testing_agent: Foundation shell verified. Dashboard renders as initial screen with stat tiles + 4 quick actions. Drawer (mobile) and permanent sidebar (desktop >=1024px) both list all 9 nav routes. Theme toggle works from both TopAppBar and Settings screen, persists across reload. Every route (/, /builder, /checker, /analyzer, /ingredients, /library, /ai-expert, /reports, /settings) renders its screen-* testID. Every empty page exposes {key}-empty and {key}-empty-cta testIDs. No horizontal overflow at 390px. No console errors during navigation.
